headline: 1,463 hospitalized in 24 hours as three more die of dengue
summary: The death toll for the year has reached 133, with over 46,000 people hospitalized across Bangladesh.
details: Three people died and 1,463 others were admitted to hospitals across the country in the last 24 hours due to dengue, according to a regular notice from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

The admissions were spread across various regions: 241 in Dhaka (outside city corporations), 192 in Dhaka North City Corporation, 169 in Dhaka South City Corporation, 255 in Khulna, 174 in Rangpur, 169 in Chattogram, 165 in Barishal, 88 in Mymensingh, and 10 in Sylhet.
According to DGHS data, the total number of deaths from dengue this year has risen to 133.
A total of 46,938 people have been hospitalized for dengue this year, while 43,553 patients have been discharged from hospitals.

According to DGHS data, the total number of deaths from dengue this year has risen to 133.

A total of 46,938 people have been hospitalized for dengue this year, while 43,553 patients have been discharged from hospitals.

headline_marked: Noakhali: [[Madrasa teacher arrested]] for allegedly raping 10-year-old student
headline: Noakhali: Madrasa teacher arrested for allegedly raping 10-year-old student
summary: The victim's family discovered the pregnancy after the girl became less attentive to her studies over several months.
details: A madrasa teacher, Maulana Emran, has been arrested in Noakhali Sadar upazila for allegedly raping a 10-year-old student over several months.
The victim's family noticed she had become less attentive to her studies and showed physical changes, leading them to take her to a private hospital on Monday.
Doctors at the private hospital confirmed that the child was pregnant, after which the girl told her parents that her teacher had raped her repeatedly.
Police said the alleged assaults occurred at Emran's residence, where he used to tutor the girl privately.
Following the news, local residents detained Emran and beat him before handing him over to the police.
Emran is currently receiving treatment under police guard at Noakhali 250-bed General Hospital and will be produced before the court once recovered.
caption:
A 10-year-old girl in Noakhali was found to be pregnant after months of alleged rape by her madrasa teacher.

A madrasa teacher, Maulana Emran, has been arrested in Noakhali Sadar upazila for allegedly raping a 10-year-old student over several months.

The victim's family noticed she had become less attentive to her studies and showed physical changes, leading them to take her to a private hospital on Monday.

Doctors at the private hospital confirmed that the child was pregnant, after which the girl told her parents that her teacher had raped her repeatedly.

Police said the alleged assaults occurred at Emran's residence, where he used to tutor the girl privately.

Following the news, local residents detained Emran and beat him before handing him over to the police.

Emran is currently receiving treatment under police guard at Noakhali 250-bed General Hospital and will be produced before the court once recovered.

#Noakhali #Bangladesh #Justice #CrimeNews #ChildProtection

Source: The Daily Star
